spec_notes:
QA round-1 fix pass, 2026-09-04. TWO recorded, non-sampler edits to this spec, both made by hand and both narrated here so no reader has to infer them.
(1) answer_positions.聴解_問題5 was [3, 1, 1] and is now [3, 1, 2]. Entries 2 and 3 of that row are 問題5-2番's 質問1 and 質問2 — the SAME item — so the drawn plan reserved a collision no official sitting has (0 of 31 in refs/JLPT_N2_NEW/*/key.md) and no prior generated paper has (0 of 21). qa-report-20260904_2 F2, an automatic fail. balanced_position_plan() draws the whole 101-key deck at once, so there is no sampler mechanism that re-draws one entry; the edit is therefore direct and minimal — one value, 1 -> 2. Legality re-measured BY HAND after the change (no gate check for the 質問1≠質問2 rule exists yet): 聴解_問題5 mode count 1, ceiling MAX_SECTION_MODE = 2; whole-paper four-choice totals move 1:23->22, 2:20->21, 3:24, 4:23, all inside POSITION_BAND 19–27 and closer to even than before; longest same-position run over the 90-item deck stays 3, at MAX_POSITION_RUN. No other item's options were permuted, so no swap was needed.
(2) quick_response entry 「社長、本日の日経新聞に弊社の記事が掲載されております。」 is now 「社長、本日の業界誌に弊社の記事が掲載されております。」. 日経新聞 is a real publication and the archive prints a real outlet name only in a 出典 attribution line under a 読解 excerpt, never in exam prose or a spoken line (qa-report-20260904_2 F5). The defect is the POOL SENTENCE, so it was corrected in .agents/exam-blueprint/references/pools.json and the corrected string carried into this spec and into logs/ledger.json, per exam-blueprint §"A quick_response entry is a SENTENCE" — check_draw_provenance() still resolves. Re-domaining it off newspapers entirely (rather than to 「朝刊」) also clears the 問題4-11番 ↔ 問題13(地方紙の廃刊) 新聞 echo the QA report recorded beside F5.
The listening_scenarios[6] change in the seed expression is NOT a hand edit: it is --reroll-one listening_scenarios:6 (seeds 27741382, 44709417, 76306785, 49327412, 57676487, 44623488, 53418667 in that order), the repair exam-blueprint prescribes for F1. 旅館:食事場所の希望確認 (食) headlined 聴解問題5-2番 the paper after 20260904_1 headlined 食 at its 問題14, which rule 4 forbids with zero tolerance. The six rejected draws each breached rule 4 or the in-paper headline-uniqueness rule on their own theme; 保健センター:生活習慣病予防講座 (睡眠・健康) is the first that clears both plus the one-repeat-against-the-2-back allowance, which 教育 at 聴解問題5-1番 had already spent.
